popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Daughter of Deimachus and wife of Aeolus son of Hellen; mother of the twelve Aeolids — seven sons and five daughters who seed the Aeolian houses.

popCulture.title: Enarete
popCulture.description: Matriarch of the Aeolids by Aeolus Hellen's son — genealogical mother of Cretheus, Sisyphus, Athamas, and their siblings.
